name: SMS Pharmaceuticals Ltd
title: SMS Pharmaceuticals Ltd - 532815 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Management guides FY27 revenue growth of 15% with EBITDA margin above FY26's 20%, citing ibuprofen backward integration and an 800 MT/month capacity build by FY27 end; a Middle East-driven solvent cost squeeze already dented Q4 gross margin by 2%.

utilisation.quote: we are almost 80% already utilizing our existing capacity

capex.quote: Upon completion of our current capex program in FY27, our installed capacity will increase to 800 metric tons per month.

triggers.label: Ibuprofen utilisation ~80%
triggers.quote: we are almost 80% already utilizing our existing capacity

triggers.label: Ibuprofen capacity 500 → 800 MT/month

triggers.label: Ibuprofen price rise from war
triggers.quote: there is a price increase also that is happening in products like ibuprofen

triggers.label: FY27 revenue growth 15%

aiming to further improve upon our FY26 EBITDA margin of 20%
